status: Closed — source repair and current framework-temp runner publication regression verified 2026-09-02
finding: A framework-temp runner-sync publication can deadlock after a governed task delivery commit: `broker runner-sync release` requires the runner-sync receipt and generated release inventory to be published first, but normal `git commit` is blocked because framework-temp claims do not have a normal task ledger/work session context for `.atm/history/evidence/ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-*.runner-sync-receipt.json`, and `node atm.mjs git commit` reports `ATM_WRITE_TICKET_MISSING` for the temp task.
expectedBehavior: Framework-temp runner-sync should provide a governed commit/publication route that pre-commit accepts without native `git commit --no-verify`, either by minting a task-context receipt, creating a work-admission ticket for the temp claim, or routing release publication through a dedicated runner-sync commit surface.
evidenceOrRepro: Original incident: during TASK-SKL-0036 close on 2026-07-30, frozen runner sync for delivery commit `aec29641f` required framework-temp claim `ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-skl-captain`; governed commit then reported `ATM_WRITE_TICKET_MISSING` and an owner-approved native emergency commit was needed. Current verification on 2026-09-02: `tests/cli/runner-sync-framework-temp-hotfix.test.ts`, `tests/cli/runner-sync-build-script-admission.test.ts`, and `tests/cli/runner-publication-reconciliation.test.ts` all passed. In the same session, framework-temp runner publication outputs and the runner-sync receipt were committed and pushed through normal `node atm.mjs git commit` / `node atm.mjs git push`, commits `7baf014437c05261d326b95c429a0d47bc0d290c` and `67342fef169aee7ef9501116fd4a48c63938fb93`, without `--no-verify` or an emergency commit path.
followUp: Closed. Keep the focused framework-temp runner publication regressions in the release validation set.
